title: No signal anywhere (intro, status, or notices) of how much of the 300-turn budget one hold costs. Playing exactly as instructed (talk to everyone, follow up, explore fully, travel beyond the first place) consumed ~290 of 300 turns finishing just the Vale of Ash (plus a side trip to neighboring Fenmarch) — one hold out of nine, and the game's own log states 'six holds, six unrested griefs. Rest three... any opens Coldpass' is only a mid-game gate, not the ending. A thorough, non-wasteful playthrough cannot reach *** WIN/*** LOSE in 300 turns; there is no way to have known that going in.
